alerts.title: Hormuz suffers weekend of fire
alerts.why: Severe military escalation in the Strait of Hormuz threatens major crude supply disruptions through a critical chokepoint.

alerts.title: At least four people killed as Russia and Ukraine trade strikes overnight
alerts.why: Refinery damage reduces crude demand (bearish CL) but constrains refined product supply, driving up HO and RB prices significantly.

alerts.title: Oil Sinks to $94 as Iran’s $8 Billion Hormuz Deal Heads to Trump
alerts.why: Potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz significantly reduces geopolitical risk premiums, leading to a sharp sell-off in global crude benchmarks.

alerts.title: IRGC strikes three tankers near Hormuz over ‘US links’
alerts.why: Geopolitical escalation in the Strait of Hormuz threatens global oil supply chokepoints, triggering immediate risk premiums in crude futures.

alerts.title: Iran: US strikes ship after Hormuz blockade breach
alerts.why: Escalation in the Strait of Hormuz threatens global oil supply routes, increasing geopolitical risk premiums for crude and refined products.

itemsSent.title: Oil Traders In Talks With US To Get Sanctioned Ships Back To Sea
itemsSent.why: Potential return of sanctioned tankers to the active fleet could increase effective global crude supply, putting downward pressure on prices.

itemsSent.title: Third-quarter U.S. GDP increases a better-than-expected 3.4% as September inflation accelerates
itemsSent.why: Stronger GDP supports energy demand, but accelerating inflation raises rate hike fears, pressuring crude and refined products in opposite directions.

itemsSent.title: Left: Pre-War crude oil exports (baseline) Middle: Past 7 days. It shows that regional departures are down. The reason for it is due to a surge in STS transfers in the GoO. Right: Week prior, when the
itemsSent.why: Regional crude exports down due to surge in Gulf of Oman STS transfers, shifting logistics without altering overall supply.

itemsSent.title: Trump says renewed Iran strikes ‘highly unlikely’ if talks progress but warns he could still strike
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical risk premium eases as Trump deems renewed Iran strikes unlikely if nuclear and shipping talks progress.

itemsSent.title: HPCL Struggles To Book Tankers For Hormuz Crude
itemsSent.why: Tanker shortages and owner withdrawals in the Strait of Hormuz complicate Persian Gulf crude liftings, raising freight costs and threatening supply flows.

itemsSent.title: Iraq Has Reached Understandings With US To Allow Oil Exports Through Hormuz
itemsSent.why: Understanding to secure Iraqi exports via Hormuz reduces supply disruption risk, exerting downward pressure on crude prices.

itemsSent.title: Iraq’s 5 Million Bpd Oil Claim Complicates Its OPEC Quota Push
itemsSent.why: Iraq admitting to producing 5 million bpd, well above its quota, signals rising overproduction risk and complicates upcoming OPEC+ compliance discussions.

itemsSent.title: What the Ship: Hormuz Crisis, War Risk Spikes, Cruise Chaos, Cable Sabotage & SS United States
itemsSent.why: Hormuz crisis and war risk spikes threaten critical Middle East crude transit, driving geopolitical risk premium into Brent prices.

itemsSent.title: China wholesale inflation hits highest in more than four years as consumer measure slows
itemsSent.why: Higher Chinese wholesale inflation suggests rising factory costs, while slowing consumer prices reflect weak domestic demand, creating mixed signals for oil.

itemsSent.title: Rubio says war on Iran unpopular but ‘necessary’ to stop nuclear threat
itemsSent.why: Escalating US-Iran rhetoric heightens Middle East geopolitical risk premiums and potential supply disruption fears.

itemsSent.title: Houthi Forces Hit Saudi Aramco's Headquarters Building
itemsSent.why: Houthi strike on Saudi Aramco HQ threatens physical security of key oil infrastructure, spiking geopolitical risk for crude and refined products.

itemsSent.title: Oil Prices Fall as Trump Signals No New Attacks on Iran
Evergreen Joins the Return to Red Sea Shipping
itemsSent.why: Return to Red Sea shipping reduces transit times and costs, easing supply chain fears and slightly weighing on crude prices.

itemsSent.title: Iraq Strikes U.S. Deal to Boost Oil Exports Through Hormuz
itemsSent.why: Increased Iraqi export capacity through the Hormuz corridor and Oman would ease supply constraints, acting as a bearish factor for crude prices.

itemsSent.title: At least one person killed as Russia and Ukraine trade strikes overnight
itemsSent.why: Drone attack on a major Russian refinery is bullish refined products by tightening supply, but bearish crude oil as domestic processing capacity drops.

itemsSent.title: Oil prices pare losses as Hormuz, Houthi tensions persist
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical risk premiums in the Middle East remain elevated due to persistent shipping threats, offsetting recent de-escalation rhetoric.

itemsSent.title: At least four killed as Russia and Ukraine trade strikes overnight
itemsSent.why: Refinery damage is bearish for crude demand but bullish for refined products due to supply constraints and potential regional shortages.

itemsSent.title: Iraq's Oil Sales to America Fall to Lowest Since the 2003 War
itemsSent.why: Reduced Iraqi exports to the U.S. tighten supply, though the market has already priced in these logistical constraints over recent months.
